description: Empirical net-efficiency curve vs warm/cold temperature difference dT. eta_net = (dT/(Tw+273.15))*eta_cycle_fraction*(1-parasitic_fraction); net power = eta_net*P_gross. Tabulated at representative Tw=26 C and interpolated; zero below dT_min.

T_warm_ref_c.note: Representative warm surface temperature for the lookup

eta_cycle_fraction.note: Fraction of Carnot achieved by real ammonia ORC

parasitic_fraction.note: Fraction of gross power consumed by pumps/auxiliaries

dT_min_c.note: Minimum temperature difference for net generation

eta_net_design.note: Net efficiency at design dT=21 C (Tw=26, Tc=5)

P_net_design_kw.note: Net power at design dT=21 C

source: Vega (2002) OTEC review; Nihous (2007) J. Energy Resour. Technol. 129:10; NREL OTEC resource assessment; reuses EC138 F1a parameters
